summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change does and the overall review verdict, written for the PR author.

risk_level.description: Overall risk of merging this change as-is.

confidence.description: How certain the finding is real given only the diff context.

category.description: Short label, e.g. consensus-determinism, actor-safety, overflow, dos, gas, error-handling, concurrency, crypto, logic, quality, performance, testing.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the affected file.

location.description: Line number or range from the diff (e.g. '142' or '142-158'), or 'n/a'.

description.description: What is wrong and the concrete failure scenario: inputs/state that trigger it and the consequence.

positive_observations.description: Things done well worth reinforcing (good invariant checks, tests, safe patterns). Empty array if none stand out.
